name: Cookies 4 Me
author: Addicting Games
description: Cookies 4 Me is a free math game. In this yummy game, you'll be playing as a monstrous cookie fiend who is addicted to the crunch of fresh baked cookies. It doesn't even matter what kind of cookies, they could be chocolate chip, cream filled, covered in sprinkles, peanut butter or full of nuts. Your only concern is hunkering down and eating up all the fresh baked snacks placed strategically all around you. But beware! like all adddictions, these cookies are only part of the plan. You aren't just eating them for the calories, for the fun, or for the reputation. You're doing it because you're trapped and you need to get out of this maze of baked goods and thus unlock new levels that are even more complex and feature even more cookies!  So, get snackin' and get thinking because you'll have to figure out a way to eat in the correct order and unravel the logic puzzles inherent in each level. This is a delicious puzzle game where you're trapped in a maze filled with cookies and you must eat them in the right order if you want to survive and escape.
